articles.title: Police Investigate Two Linked Sexual Assaults in Milnrow
articles.excerpt: Detectives are investigating two linked sexual assaults that occurred in Milnrow, Rochdale, prompting a police inquiry into the incidents.
articles.content_html:
Detectives are investigating two linked sexual assaults that took place in Milnrow, Rochdale. The incidents have raised concerns within the community as police work to gather information.

The assaults reportedly occurred within a short timeframe, although specific details regarding the victims or the exact locations have not been disclosed.

Authorities are urging anyone with information related to these incidents to come forward to assist with the investigation.

Anyone with information can find Greater Manchester Police and Crimestoppers contact details at the end of this article.
